final.name: Conversational scaffolding
final.audit_justification: Detects formulaic/routine dialogue-reply templates by presence alone, which is boilerplate framing rather than evidence the joke itself works.

final.name: Scene-anchored concrete object nouns
final.audit_justification: Counts presence of concrete nouns without judging fit or skill, but a writer's habit of grounding scenes in specific picturable objects plausibly also correlates with genuinely sharper writing.

final.name: Role/status inversion
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a real comic mechanism (an unexpected authority reversal) is present, which is a substantive craft device.

final.name: Payoff-bearing specificity
final.audit_justification: Explicitly distinguishes specificity that sharpens the premise from specificity that is decorative, i.e. it judges execution quality, not mere presence.

final.name: Revealing Character Voice
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the wording is distinctively tied to a particular speaker, a genuine craft/content property of the caption.

final.name: Caption length
final.audit_justification: Pure word/clause count; the prompt itself disclaims that longer is better, and length has no clear upstream link to comedic craft in a caption contest.

final.name: Late-Line Pivot
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the comic reveal is well-placed and earned by a credible setup, a genuine timing/craft judgment.

final.name: Stacked / compound double meanings
final.audit_justification: Counts independent, load-bearing wordplay mechanisms, which is substantive comic content/craft, not a stylistic tell.

final.name: Vocative first names and named-addressee direct address
final.audit_justification: Scores presence/prominence of an address term regardless of whether the name is well chosen, but engaging a specific addressee plausibly co-occurs with genuine character-voice craft.
final.upstream_parent: veteran-entrant imitation of the venue's published-caption house style

final.name: Borrowed phrase markers
final.audit_justification: Flags resemblance to stock lines/catchphrases without judging transformation, which more plausibly signals unoriginality (cliché) than genuine quality.
final.upstream_parent: professional assistance or prior exposure to cultural templates

final.name: Verbal Compression
final.audit_justification: Judges economy and non-redundancy of wording relative to the premise, a direct craft judgment.

final.name: Ellipsis/dash pause-timing punctuation
final.audit_justification: Scores presence of ellipsis/dash punctuation regardless of whether it improves timing, but this orthographic habit plausibly tracks deliberate comic-timing craft judged elsewhere.

final.name: Natural Spoken Cadence
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the line reads as believable natural speech versus an assembled fragment, a genuine craft property.

final.name: News-cycle / dated-event topicality anchor
final.audit_justification: A textbook temporal tell (dates the item to a news moment) that explicitly disclaims judging cleverness, though topical engagement could plausibly also yield sharper material.
final.upstream_parent: submission timing relative to news cycle / editorial recency bias

final.name: Specialist abbreviation / acronym shorthand
final.audit_justification: Detects specialist jargon as a fingerprint of the writer's domain background; that background/expertise could plausibly also produce a sharper inside-knowledge joke.

final.name: Topical reference integration
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a reference is essential to and transformed by the joke's mechanism versus detachable name-dropping, a genuine craft distinction.

final.name: Implied conversational premise
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the line convincingly implies a believable unstated exchange, a substantive craft property.

final.name: Freshness beyond stock jokes
final.audit_justification: Directly judges originality versus cliché reproduction, core to whether the caption is a good contest entry.

final.name: Concrete absurd escalation
final.audit_justification: Judges whether escalation is specific and disproportionate versus random, a genuine comic-craft judgment.

final.name: Visualizable physical staging
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the wording conjures a clear comic physical arrangement, substantive comedic content.

final.name: Deadpan Underreaction
final.audit_justification: Judges tonal control (calm treatment of high-stakes material), a genuine comic-craft device.

final.name: Editorial elaboration
final.audit_justification: Scores syntactic elaboration and clause-linking while explicitly disclaiming writing quality, though general verbal sophistication plausibly also correlates with genuinely better-crafted lines.

final.name: Specific numeric quantity citation
final.audit_justification: Scores mere presence of numeric quantities without judging aptness, but deliberate numeric specificity plausibly correlates with the sharper-premise craft judged in kin criteria.
final.upstream_parent: numeric-caption visual salience during editorial skim / vote tallying

final.name: Scene-Conscious Meta-Awareness
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the caption self-awarely exploits presentational conventions, a genuine comedic device.

final.name: Semantic Hinge
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a genuine two-reading pivot is constructed, substantive wordplay craft rather than a stylistic tell.
